description: The third-party skill suite behind the optional shelf (47 optional skills and the browse runtime plumbing). Fetched during onboarding from this pinned revision; never trusted until verified.

archive.digest_note: tar_sha256 is the digest of the gunzipped tar stream and is authoritative; a re-compressed archive with the same tar stream still verifies. Digests were taken from two independent downloads on 2026-10-13.

licence.retention: The notice installs beside every projected copy of an upstream skill and is never removed by a patch.

provenance.modifications: Rig renamed the product namespace (gstack to rig, gbrain to brain), omitted dependencies, fixtures, generated bundles, source maps and release history, and neutralised illustrative credential-shaped strings. The result is a modified, partial distribution, not an upstream release.
